query: with start as ( select date_trunc($1, coalesce(now() - $2::text::interval, (select min(created_at) from files)) at time zone 'UTC') as at), per_step as ( select date_trunc($1, created_at at time zone 'UTC') as step, count(*) as files, sum(size) as bytes from files, start where created_at at time zone 'UTC' >= start.at group by 1), earlier as ( select count(*) as files, coalesce(sum(size), 0) as bytes from files, start where created_at at time zone 'UTC' < start.at) select to_char(step, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS"Z"') as "period!", (earlier.files + sum(coalesce(per_step.files, 0)) over (order by step))::bigint as "files!", (earlier.bytes + sum(coalesce(per_step.bytes, 0)) over (order by step))::bigint as "bytes!", coalesce(per_step.files, 0) as "uploads!", coalesce(per_step.bytes, 0)::bigint as "uploaded_bytes!" from earlier, start, generate_series(start.at, now() at time zone 'UTC', ('1 ' || $1)::interval) as step left join per_step using (step) order by step
